proposals.evidence: DEDR 1711 full article: Ka. kudire, kudure, kudare id., a knight at chess; cock of a gun. Koḍ. kudïre horse. Tu. kudurè id.; lock of a gun, (B-K.) catch of an umbrella; (B-K.) grasshopper. Te. kudira, kudaramu horse. Cf. 1705 Ta.… Tamil kutirai and Kannada kudire mean “horse”; Census kutira is the horse stem.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2591 full article: Ka. eṟake, eṟaṅke, ṟakke, ṟekke wing; ṟaṭṭe, ṟeṭṭe wing, upper arm. Koḍ. rekke wing; raṭṭe upper arm. Tu. ediṅke, reṅkè wing. Te. eṟaka, ṟekka, rekka, neṟaka, neṟi id. Kol. reḍapa, (SR.) reppā id.; (P.) reṛapa… The article lists Kannada ṟekke, Kodagu rekke and Telugu rekka for “wing”; Census rekka has the wing sense.
